CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: Real cast time for WHM/RDM/BLM spells (JOB_SPELL_SYSTEM_NORTHSTAR.md §1 Phase 1 remainder): new apps2/mud/ability.go -- spellCastTimes gives every already-shipped WHM/RDM/BLM spell a real, non-zero cast time for the first time (was instant, gated only by the 1s universal lockout). beginCast defers the exact existing effect logic via time.AfterFunc after a fast MP/target preflight; checkNotCasting is a real shared gate both cmdCast and cmdJA now call. 11 new tests, go test ./... clean. Live-verified in production: 'cast cure' shows 'You begin casting Cure... (2s)', an immediate ja attempt is refused ('already casting'), and the effect lands automatically ~2s later. Isolated from a concurrent in-flight main.go change via the established hunk technique. Commit 8b4f561. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
